title: Paper Crown
lyrics:
[intro]

[verse]
I found you face down in the dark
Gave you a pulse, gave you a spark
I stitched your name into my skin
And let you walk right out again

[pre-chorus]
And every time you swore you'd stay
You were already halfway gone

[chorus]
So wear your paper crown
I'm the one who made it
Watch it all burn down
Baby, you can't fake it
I gave you every piece of gold I had
You melted it for someone else's hand
Wear your paper crown

[verse]
Now they all sing your name so loud
You never say mine out loud
I was the mirror, you were the light
I only shined when you were right

[pre-chorus]
And every time you swore you'd stay
You were already halfway gone

[chorus]
So wear your paper crown
I'm the one who made it
Watch it all burn down
Baby, you can't fake it
I gave you every piece of gold I had
You melted it for someone else's hand
Wear your paper crown

[bridge]
I don't want you back
I want the years
I want the girl I was before the tears
She's still in here somewhere
She's still in here

[chorus]
So wear your paper crown
I'm the one who made it
Watch it all burn down
Baby, you can't fake it

[outro]
Wear your paper crown
Wear your paper crown
style: dark pop, alt-pop, female vocal, sparse minimal production, trap-influenced hi-hats, deep sub bass, moody electric piano, breathy intimate verses building to a belted emotional chorus, 136 BPM, D minor, 4/4, melancholic and cinematic, modern radio pop production, heavy reverb, vulnerable and defiant
